final: SELECT hand AS bats, COUNT(DISTINCT player_id) AS managers, COUNT(DISTINCT player_id) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT player_id)) OVER () AS share FROM (SELECT ma.player_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.bats), ''), '') AS hand FROM manager_award ma JOIN player p ON p.player_id = ma.player_id) GROUP BY hand
